invariants.rationale: The method should return a non-null metadata object as a result of the delete operation.
The input list of keys to delete should not be null when the method returns.
The instantTime parameter, which specifies the commit/operation time, should not be null at method exit.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is necessary for the delete operation and should not be null.
The list of WriteStatus within the returned metadata should not be null after a delete operation.
